commit bc6bbe5b537b6d6a637f1ab988628fafaf27061b
Author:     Martin Giger <martin@humanoids.be>
AuthorDate: Mon Nov 25 16:49:05 2024 +0000
Commit:     Martin Giger <martin@humanoids.be>
CommitDate: Mon Nov 25 16:49:05 2024 +0000

    Bug 1922551 - Enable in-app notifications by default. r=tobyp
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D229788

diff --git a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
index 0467d1f9ef7..4371484a365 100644
--- a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
+++ b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
@@ -1410,11 +1410,11 @@ pref("dom.disable_window_flip", true);
 pref("browser.theme.dark-private-windows", true);
 
 // In-app notifications are disabled while the feature is being implemented.
-pref("mail.inappnotifications.enabled", false);
+pref("mail.inappnotifications.enabled", true);
 // Refresh interval for in-app notifications in ms (6 hours)
 pref("mail.inappnotifications.refreshInterval", 21600000);
-// In-app notification server endpoint
-pref("mail.inappnotifications.url", "https://notifications-stage.thunderbird.net/notifications.json");
+// In-app notification server endpoint is specified by branding prefs.
+
 // Disables all filtering of in-app notifications, useful for testing.
 pref("mail.inappnotifications.bypass-filtering", false);
 
diff --git a/mail/base/test/browser/browser.ini b/mail/base/test/browser/browser.ini
index 9c832d6f17a..7841e801bc6 100644
--- a/mail/base/test/browser/browser.ini
+++ b/mail/base/test/browser/browser.ini
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@ prefs =
   mailnews.start_page.url=about:blank
   mailnews.default_sort_order=1
 subsuite = thunderbird
-support-files = 
+support-files =
   files/**
   head_editMenu.js
 
diff --git a/mail/branding/include/release-prefs.js b/mail/branding/include/release-prefs.js
index f7f88edc711..6a7efb7589d 100644
--- a/mail/branding/include/release-prefs.js
+++ b/mail/branding/include/release-prefs.js
@@ -24,3 +24,6 @@ pref("app.update.badgeWaitTime", 345600);
 pref("app.vendorURL", "https://www.thunderbird.net/%LOCALE%/");
 
 pref("browser.search.param.ms-pc", "MOZT");
+
+// In-app notification server endpoint
+pref("mail.inappnotifications.url", "https://notifications.thunderbird.net/notifications.json");
diff --git a/mail/branding/nightly/pref/thunderbird-branding.js b/mail/branding/nightly/pref/thunderbird-branding.js
index 4cb854f46ee..65aa199d7e3 100644
--- a/mail/branding/nightly/pref/thunderbird-branding.js
+++ b/mail/branding/nightly/pref/thunderbird-branding.js
@@ -35,3 +35,6 @@ pref("app.update.checkInstallTime.days", 2);
 pref("app.update.badgeWaitTime", 0);
 
 pref("app.vendorURL", "https://www.thunderbird.net/%LOCALE%/");
+
+// In-app notification server endpoint
+pref("mail.inappnotifications.url", "https://notifications-stage.thunderbird.net/notifications.json");
diff --git a/mail/components/inappnotifications/test/browser/browser_disabled.toml b/mail/components/inappnotifications/test/browser/browser_disabled.toml
index 9841ab1affc..55ca202814a 100644
--- a/mail/components/inappnotifications/test/browser/browser_disabled.toml
+++ b/mail/components/inappnotifications/test/browser/browser_disabled.toml
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 [DEFAULT]
 prefs = [
+  "mail.inappnotifications.enabled=false",
   "mail.provider.suppress_dialog_on_startup=true",
   "mail.rights.override=true",
   "mail.spotlight.firstRunDone=true",
